decks.notes: This Jund aggro deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value while dealing damage to the opponent. The main strategy is to use cards like Witch's Oven and Mayhem Devil to generate token creatures and ping the opponent for small amounts of damage repeatedly. Fatal Push and Scavenger's Talent provide removal and disruption, while Blazemire Verge and Blightstep Pathway ensure consistent mana base. The deck also includes some cards for card advantage and additional sacrifice synergies. Overall, the key concept is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature sacrifice and direct damage.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on efficiently deploying creatures with disruptive abilities while using cards like Collected Company to further flood the board with threats. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria slow down opponents' spells, while Skyclave Apparition and Anointed Peacekeeper offer removal options. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of aggressive creatures and disruption, utilizing mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves to quickly cast its spells and maintain pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards that allow for creative and unexpected combos, utilizing spells like Volcanic Spite and Shark Typhoon to control the board and generate value. Generating tokens and triggering effects from cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Valgavoth, Terror Eater, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy and outmaneuver them with clever plays. With a mix of counter spells like Negate and powerful spells like Dig Through Time, the deck offers a versatile approach to controlling the game while setting up game-winning combos.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with cheap and efficient creatures like Ghitu Lavarunner and Monastery Swiftspear, backed up by burn spells like Play with Fire and Skewer the Critics to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The deck also utilizes cards like Light Up the Stage and Slickshot Show-Off to maintain card advantage and pressure the opponent. With a strong emphasis on dealing damage quickly and efficiently, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory before they have a chance to stabilize.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using green devotion cards such as Llanowar Elves, Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and Wolfwillow Haven to power out powerful creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns. The strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays, while also utilizing cards like Storm the Festival and Invasion of Ixalan to generate card advantage and maintain board presence. The inclusion of cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Ulvenwald Oddity provides additional versatility and resilience against removal spells. The deck aims to win through a combination of efficient creature beatdowns and massive mana advantage.

The deck focuses on aggressive tactics by utilizing powerful creatures and removal spells to quickly eliminate the opponent's threats and reduce their life total. The deck also includes cards that provide additional value and disruption to control the pace of the game. With a mix of aggressive creatures, targeted removal, and disruptive spells, the deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent and secure a swift victory. The inclusion of versatile lands and powerful legendary creatures adds depth and flexibility to the strategy, ensuring a dynamic and varied gameplay experience.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to trigger powerful effects, such as dealing damage to opponents or stealing their creatures. It utilizes cards like Cauldron Familiar, Mayhem Devil, and Witch's Oven to maintain board presence and pressure opponents. Claim the Firstborn allows for stealing key creatures from opponents, while cards like Thoughtseize provide disruption and control. The deck also includes land cards that provide utility and flexibility, such as Den of the Bugbear and Blazemire Verge. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays and strategic sacrifices.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays, utilizing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage alongside burn spells like Skewer the Critics and Wizard's Lightning to deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Ramunap Ruins and Den of the Bugbear for additional reach and card advantage. With a focus on quickly reducing the opponent's life total, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize or mount a defense.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also applying pressure with early aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also includes removal spells like Go for the Throat and Fatal Push to deal with threats on the board. Additionally, it has some powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Blade of the Oni to close out the game. The deck aims to be fast and efficient, ending the game before the opponent has a chance to respond.

This aggro deck focuses on utilizing creature abilities and a mix of green and white cards to overwhelm opponents quickly. By casting efficient creatures like Archon of Emeria and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, the deck aims to disrupt opponents' plans while building a strong board presence with cards like Skyclave Apparition and Knight of Autumn. With ramp from cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, the deck can quickly deploy threats and apply pressure, ultimately aiming to close out the game before opponents can stabilize.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of multicolored cards and lands to control the game and generate value with Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful card advantage engine. With a strong mana base and a mix of removal, ramp, and versatile spells, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and control the board until it can establish a dominant position. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion for additional value and synergy with the deck's focus on multicolored cards. The goal is to grind out opponents with card advantage and powerful threats like Niv-Mizzet, Supreme.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful multicolor cards to control the game and out-value opponents. By having access to a wide variety of colors and options, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage through cards like Niv-Mizzet Reborn and Bring to Light. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Vanishing Verse helps to deal with threats efficiently, while cards like Sylvan Caryatid and Up the Beanstalk provide ramp and fixing. Overall, the goal is to control the board and outlast opponents with a versatile and resilient strategy.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of removal and disruption to control the pace of the game. It utilizes powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Blade of the Oni to quickly overwhelm opponents while also running a suite of removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with threats. The inclusion of cards like Duress and Thoughtseize helps disrupt opponents' strategies, allowing the deck to maintain pressure and secure victories. The combination of aggressive creatures and disruption spells makes this deck a force to be reckoned with in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria, while disrupting their game plan with Aven Interrupter and Skyclave Apparition. The deck aims to control the board and overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of threats. Collected Company provides additional creature advantage, while mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves help ramp up to the bigger threats. The deck is built to be fast, proactive, and relentless in its aggression.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on deploying aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero to deal damage quickly to the opponent. Cards like Reckless Rage and Monstrous Rage provide removal and pump effects to keep the pressure on. By leveraging the powerful synergy between creatures and spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win through combat damage. The inclusion of utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance ensures the deck can continue to apply pressure even in the late game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming your opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. Utilizing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Callous Sell-Sword, along with pump spells like Infuriate and Monstrous Rage, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provide additional reach in the late game. By playing aggressively and efficiently managing resources, this deck aims to pressure the opponent and close out games before they can stabilize.
